title: Studio 关联字段和汇总字段的目标只能选对象，不再接受随手输入的文字
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

① product defect · Source: maintainer (Warren), 2026-11-23, UI review thread.
- 14:23Z 「还有哪些元数据可能会有问题？同时全面的测试 studio的各项功能」
- 15:09Z 「用fable 评审一下 studio的问题，提出修改方案」
- 15:23Z, decision card 「Studio 评审的 9 张卡，按 fable 方案立卡吗？」 → **「9 张全立」**

Evidence:
- Fable code review on main 9e0c0c23: project file `ui-review-2026-11-23/fable-studio-review.md`.
- Browser screenshots: `ui-review-2026-11-23/round2/`.
- Round-2 report: https://claude.ai/artifact/X5ukNAgphAq5vDpDAT6SAD

Paths are relative to `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` unless they start with `ui/` or `packages/`. `SDS` = `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. `zh` = `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`. Line numbers are on 9e0c0c23.

## What (review r08, root cause 4)
The Lookup door accepts any typed text as its target object, because `objectsOnly` is off (`metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:1769–1777`). No expression is legal there (`metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectPicker.tsx:274–280`), so a typo saves a Lookup to an object that does not exist. The summary (roll-up) target door has the same gap.

## Expected
Pass `objectsOnly` on the Lookup and summary target doors.

**Premise to verify first.** The picker's catalog must list an object that exists only as an AI draft. Otherwise a Lookup to it could not be set. If it does not, report a fork to the seat; do not quietly allow free text.

## Acceptance
- A test pins that the Lookup and summary target pickers refuse free text and accept a listed object.
- A test covers a draft-only object as a target, per the premise.

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · Impeded · builders, often ⇒ p2. Effort S. Evidence: read (review r08).

Dedupe: no open card names `objectsOnly`.
